goal.en: Pack information into noun phrases and participle clauses the way professional prose does — without losing the reader.
goal.ar: أن تكثّف المعلومات في العبارات الاسمية وجمل اسم الفاعل كما يفعل النثر المهني، دون أن تُضيع القارئ.

text.en: English can load several words in front of a noun where Arabic would use a chain after it: “a three-year government-funded pilot scheme”.
text.ar: تستطيع الإنجليزية تكديس عدة كلمات قبل الاسم، بينما تضعها العربية سلسلةً بعده: «مشروع تجريبي ممول حكومياً مدته ثلاث سنوات».

head: Unpacked
Packed
rows: a scheme that lasts three years
a policy on the safety of food
a decision taken at the last minute

text.en: A number used as a modifier stays singular and takes a hyphen: “a three-year scheme”, not “a three years scheme”.
text.ar: العدد المستخدم صفةً يبقى مفرداً ويأخذ شرطة: a three-year scheme ولا نقول a three years scheme.

text.en: Two or three modifiers read well; five do not. “A newly revised regional customer data protection procedure” is a sentence pretending to be a noun.
text.ar: وصفان أو ثلاثة تُقرأ بسلاسة، أما خمسة فلا. فعبارة مثل a newly revised regional customer data protection procedure جملة متنكّرة في هيئة اسم.

text.en: Drop the relative pronoun and the verb “be”: “the report which was submitted last week” → “the report submitted last week”.
text.ar: نحذف الاسم الموصول وفعل الكون: the report which was submitted last week تصير the report submitted last week.

head: Full
Reduced
Form
rows: the man who is waiting outside
the letter that was sent on Monday
the option which is available now

text.en: The -ing form must belong to the noun it follows. “Walking through the door, the smell hit me” says the smell was walking. Fix the subject, not the comma.
text.ar: يجب أن ينتمي اسم الفاعل إلى الاسم الذي يليه. فجملة Walking through the door, the smell hit me تجعل الرائحة هي التي تمشي، والعلاج تصحيح الفاعل لا الفاصلة.

title.en: Participle clauses that open a sentence
title.ar: جمل اسم الفاعل في مطلع الجملة

head: Meaning
Example
rows: Having reviewed the data, we revised the estimate.
Faced with rising costs, the firm cut its plans.
Taken together, the results are encouraging.
Sales fell sharply, forcing a rethink.

text.en: The subject of the participle must be the subject of the main clause. “Having reviewed the data, we revised …” works because “we” did both.
text.ar: يجب أن يكون فاعل اسم الفاعل هو فاعل الجملة الرئيسية. فجملة Having reviewed the data, we revised صحيحة لأن «نحن» فعلنا الأمرين.

text.en: These clauses are compact and formal. Two in a paragraph tighten your prose; five make it airless.
text.ar: هذه الجمل مكثّفة ورسمية. اثنتان في الفقرة تشدّان نصّك، وخمس تخنقه.

questions.sentence: The council approved a ___ pilot scheme for the district.
options: three-year
three years
three-years
three year's

explanation.en: A number modifying a noun is singular and hyphenated: a three-year scheme.
explanation.ar: العدد حين يصف اسماً يبقى مفرداً ويأخذ شرطة: a three-year scheme.

prompt.en: Pack this into a noun phrase: “a policy dealing with the safety of food”
prompt.ar: كثّف العبارة في صيغة اسمية: سياسة تتعلق بسلامة الغذاء

options: a food safety policy
a policy of food safety
a safety-of-food policy
a policy for food safe

explanation.en: Modifiers stack in front of the head noun, in the order general to specific.
explanation.ar: تتراكم الأوصاف أمام الاسم الرئيسي، من العام إلى الخاص.

prompt.en: Which noun phrase is too heavily loaded to read easily?
prompt.ar: أي عبارة اسمية محمّلة أكثر مما تُقرأ بسهولة؟

options: a newly revised regional customer data protection procedure
a revised procedure for protecting customer data
the regional data protection procedure, recently revised
a new procedure covering regional customer data

explanation.en: Six modifiers before the head noun force the reader to hold everything in suspense.
explanation.ar: ستة أوصاف قبل الاسم الرئيسي تُجبر القارئ على تعليق المعنى كله في ذهنه.

options: a ten-days delay in the schedule
a ten-day delay in the schedule
a last-minute change to the plan
a five-star review of the hotel

explanation.en: The number-plus-noun modifier is singular: a ten-day delay.
explanation.ar: صيغة العدد مع الاسم وصفاً تبقى مفردة: a ten-day delay.

prompt.en: Reduce the clause: “the report which was submitted last week”
prompt.ar: اختصر الجملة الموصولة: the report which was submitted last week

options: the report submitted last week
the report submitting last week
the report was submitted last week
the report it submitted last week

explanation.en: Drop “which was”; the past participle carries the passive meaning.
explanation.ar: نحذف which was، ويحمل التصريف الثالث المعنى المبني للمجهول.

questions.sentence: Anyone ___ to attend should register before Thursday.
options: wishing
wished
who wish
wishes

explanation.en: “Anyone wishing to attend” reduces “anyone who wishes”; the -ing form is active.
explanation.ar: عبارة anyone wishing to attend اختصار لـ anyone who wishes، وصيغة ing هنا للمبني للمعلوم.

prompt.en: Which pair means the same as “the students taught by Dr Nasr”?
prompt.ar: أي عبارة تعادل the students taught by Dr Nasr؟

options: the students whom Dr Nasr teaches
the students who teach Dr Nasr
the students teaching with Dr Nasr
the students and Dr Nasr together

explanation.en: The -ed form is passive: the students receive the teaching.
explanation.ar: صيغة التصريف الثالث مبنية للمجهول، فالطلاب هم من يتلقّون التدريس.

prompt.en: Which sentence says something the writer did not mean?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تقول غير ما قصده الكاتب؟

options: Walking through the door, the smell hit me immediately.
As I walked through the door, the smell hit me immediately.
Walking through the door, I noticed the smell immediately.
The smell hit me as soon as I walked through the door.

explanation.en: The participle attaches to the nearest subject, so this sentence has the smell walking.
explanation.ar: يرتبط اسم الفاعل بأقرب فاعل، فتصير الرائحة في هذه الجملة هي التي تمشي.

questions.sentence: ___ the data, the team revised its estimate downwards.
options: Having reviewed
Reviewed
To have reviewed
Having been reviewed

explanation.en: “Having reviewed” shows the team completed one action before the next.
explanation.ar: having reviewed تدل على أن الفريق أنهى فعلاً قبل الآخر.

prompt.en: “Faced with falling demand, the firm closed two sites.” What does the opening clause give?

options: The reason for the decision.
The time the sites closed.
A condition that was never met.
The result of the closures.

explanation.en: A participle clause can carry reason as well as time — context decides which.
explanation.ar: جملة اسم الفاعل قد تحمل السبب كما تحمل الزمن، والسياق هو الفاصل.

prompt.en: Which sentence has a dangling participle?
prompt.ar: أي جملة فيها اسم فاعل معلّق بلا فاعل صحيح؟

options: Having finished the audit, the report was filed at once.
Having finished the audit, we filed the report at once.
After we finished the audit, the report was filed at once.
The report was filed as soon as we finished the audit.

explanation.en: The report did not finish the audit. The participle's subject must match the main clause's.
explanation.ar: التقرير لم يُنهِ المراجعة. فيجب أن يطابق فاعل اسم الفاعل فاعل الجملة الرئيسية.

questions.answer: Taken together these findings suggest a clear pattern

explanation.en: “Taken together” is a fixed opening participle phrase in research writing.
explanation.ar: عبارة Taken together افتتاحية ثابتة في الكتابة البحثية.

prompt.en: Reduce it: “the passengers who are waiting at gate four” → “the passengers ___ at gate four”
prompt.ar: اختصرها: the passengers ___ at gate four

explanation.en: Drop “who are” and keep the -ing form for an active meaning.
explanation.ar: نحذف who are ونبقي صيغة ing للدلالة على المعلوم.

prompt.en: Which version reads best in a report?

options: We have introduced a revised customer complaints procedure.
We have introduced a procedure of complaints of customers revised.
We have introduced a revised procedure of the complaints customer.
We have introduced a customer of complaints revised new procedure.

explanation.en: Three modifiers, in a natural order, ahead of the head noun.
explanation.ar: ثلاثة أوصاف بترتيب طبيعي أمام الاسم الرئيسي.

prompt.en: Which sentence uses a participle clause most effectively?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تستخدم جملة اسم الفاعل بأفضل صورة؟

options: Costs rose sharply, forcing the board to delay the launch.
Costs rose sharply, and forcing the board to delay the launch.
Costs rose sharply, the board forcing to delay the launch.
Costs rising sharply, forcing the board delaying the launch.

explanation.en: The -ing clause expresses the result of the main clause, with no conjunction needed.
explanation.ar: جملة ing تعبّر عن نتيجة الجملة الرئيسية دون حاجة إلى أداة ربط.
